subject: general
question: Dhanurveda is the upveda of the Yajurveda. It deals with:
solution:
The correct answer is __**art of warfare.**__

__
 
• Dhanurveda is related to Archery__ __(Weapon)__.
 
• The word Dhanurveda comes from "Dhanus" meaning bow and "Veda" meaning knowledge means the science of archery.
 
• Dhanurveda is an ancient treatise on the science of archery and the art of warfare.
 
• Dhanurveda is the upveda of the Yajurveda
